description: MainActivity.kt defines the main Android activity for a Tic Tac Toe game, managing UI components, game state, user interactions, and game logic integration via GameEngine.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages the UI and game flow for the Tic Tac Toe Android app, handling user interactions, displaying game state, and coordinating with GameEngine.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, restores game state if available, and sets up event handlers.

methods.name: wireUpBoard
methods.description: Associates click listeners to each cell in the game grid for user moves.

methods.name: updateUIFromEngine
methods.description: Updates the UI to reflect the current game state, including the board, scoreboard, and status messages.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Dynamically resolves layout resource IDs to avoid compile-time R references.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current game state and user preferences to handle configuration changes like screen rotations.
